name: DIVERSITY CLOUD EUROPE
notes:
**DIVERSITY** (AS213615) operates a European network across four facilities: three self-operated sites in Madrid, Munich, and Helsinki, plus colocation at Amsterdam.

All peers must maintain a complete PeeringDB entry and 24x7 NOC. Peering sessions are provisioned via PeeringDB; ASN admins listed on PeeringDB are authorized to request peering. The number of prefixes advertised will vary across sessions and over time.

Networks exchanging more than 1 Gbps of traffic in a single location may request a PNI. Contact peering@corp.ondiversity.eu.

Submit abuse reports to **abuse@corp.ondiversity.eu**.
Do not send abuse reports to NOC or peering contacts.
